library.description: Bundled exercise identity, equipment, category, and form instructions.

ebben2011.description: Table 1: regular push-up 64%, hands elevated 30.48 cm 55%, feet elevated 30.48 cm 70%. Peak-force coefficients are used as tracking estimates, not personalized measurements.

hevy.description: Full-bodyweight convention for pull-ups and chin-ups.

kinoku.description: Published tracking estimates: squat 65%, bench dip 65%, parallel dip 98%; partial-body movements without a measured coefficient use an estimated 70% fallback.

kinoku_table.description: Published estimates: inverted row 55%, pistol squat 95%, pike push-up 80%.

segments.description: Dempster segment fractions: one leg 16.1%, both legs 32.2%, head and trunk 57.8%. Application to exercises is an EVOLVE estimate, not a measured resistance coefficient.

evolve.description: EVOLVE full-body movement tracking convention; an estimate, not an experimentally measured exercise coefficient.

external.basis: External resistance; bodyweight percentage is inactive.

partial.basis: Fallback tracking estimate for a partial-body movement.

pushup.basis: Research-derived peak-force coefficient used as a tracking estimate.

incline_pushup.basis: Estimate assumes hands raised about 30 cm; setup changes the fraction.

decline_pushup.basis: Estimate assumes feet raised about 30 cm; setup changes the fraction.

plank.basis: EVOLVE estimate using standard push-up support as a reference for a prone hold.

squat.basis: Published tracking estimate; not a measured fraction for this athlete.

bench_dip.basis: Published tracking estimate with feet supported.

dip.basis: Published tracking estimate for suspended dips.

row.basis: Published tracking estimate; body angle changes the fraction.

pistol.basis: Published tracking estimate for a single-leg squat.

legs.basis: EVOLVE estimate from the mass of both legs.

leg.basis: EVOLVE estimate from the mass of one leg.

torso.basis: EVOLVE estimate from head and trunk segment mass.

mobility.basis: Low-load mobility tracking estimate, not measured supported bodyweight.

moving_body.basis: EVOLVE estimate counting the moving body for jumps or an unsupported handstand push-up.
